title: Google Drive Connection and Scope Readiness Manual UI and Live Provider Evidence
reason: Owner Google Cloud project OAuth credentials and live interactive consent remain unconfigured; production Google provider fails closed with fake provider rejected in production runtimes under DEF-V2-005.

unmetGates.description: Owner configuration of Google Cloud project with Google Drive API and Google Picker API enabled, OAuth consent screen configured for narrow drive.file scope, Web client ID/secret and Android client ID configured, and DAYNORI_DRIVE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID / SECRET populated.

Interactive owner sign-in with live Google account through system browser / Custom Tabs verifying that consent screen requests only drive.file scope, succeeds code exchange, and issues functional Picker tokens.

ownerVerificationSteps: 1. Follow docs/engineering/google-drive-oauth-configuration-guide.md to set up Google Cloud project, OAuth consent screen (drive.file scope only), and Web/Android OAuth client credentials.
2. Configure DAYNORI_DRIVE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID, DAYNORI_DRIVE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET, DAYNORI_DRIVE_TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY, and DAYNORI_DRIVE_PRODUCTION_ENABLED=true in production environment secrets.

3. Run automated verification suites: pnpm vitest run tests/integration/phase87-drive-connection-readiness.test.ts tests/integration/phase49-drive-connector.test.ts tests/security/phase49-drive-connector.test.ts tests/spikes/drive/drive-scope.synthetic.test.ts (all 46 tests must pass).
4. In Web UI (Settings > Drive Connections), verify that the copy vs. reference explanatory card is displayed, vault disclaimer is visible, and connecting initiates OAuth to accounts.google.com.
5. In Mobile UI (DriveConnectionsSheet), verify that Custom Tabs opens for Google consent, narrow drive.file is requested, and copy vs. reference distinction is shown.
6. Verify disconnect wipes stored tokens, increments generation, cancels pending jobs, preserves imported copies in Daynori, and leaves Google Drive originals intact.
7. Retain DEF-V2-005 in docs/roadmap/v2/function-register.json until live Google account verification is completed.
